pending_interview.category: System design (ML/AI-specific) — RAG at scale, eval pipeline design, recommendation systems, agent platforms, feature store design
pending_interview.question: Your company is building a RAG system — Retrieval-Augmented Generation, where a language model answers questions by first searching a knowledge base for relevant documents and then generating a response based on what it finds. The system needs to serve 50,000 queries per day across a knowledge base of 10 million documents, and answer quality is business-critical. Walk through how you would design the end-to-end system: what components you need, how retrieval actually works at this scale, how you would measure whether answers are good, and what you would do when answer quality degrades in production. What are the key tradeoffs in your design?
